name: Space Pumping
description:
At some point you may have wondered: There are these enormous gas planets in the solar system - could there be a way to "harvest" them? Indeed there is. By constructing the "Planetary Gas Siphon" multiblock, you are able to pump from the infinite supply of gas found on Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune. You just need to build a space station around a gas planet to get close enough to reach the gas without falling into it.

Different gases can be extracted by pumping at different depths which is controlled by a Programmed Circuit. You need to supply (64 * depth) Mining Pipes to reach the selected depth.

While operational, the multiblock needs §3d*4^(T+2)§r EU/t where T is the tier of the space station and d is the depth.

You do not need a minimum tier of coil to siphon particular gas types, but you will get a §2§l10%§r speed boost per coil tier.

You probably also want a good overview of what you can get with your Planetary Gas Siphon, and the tiers of the gas giants. So here we go:

Jupiter (Tier 3)
1 Hydrogen - 15000 L/s
2 Helium - 500 L/s
3 Nitrogen - 300 L/s
4 Oxygen - 200 L/s

Saturn (Tier 5)
1 Hydrogen - 18000 L/s
2 Helium - 800 L/s
3 Oxygen - 500 L/s
4 Liquid Oxygen - 150 L/s

Uranus (Tier 5)
1 Deuterium - 5000 L/s
2 Neon - 450 L/s
3 Argon - 250 L/s
4 Krypton - 100 L/s

Neptune (Tier 6)
1 Tritium - 3000 L/s
2 Helium-3 - 500 L/s
3 Ammonia - 400 L/s
4 Xenon - 350 L/s
